source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of accessible content (PDF 190).

blocks.text: Accessible digital content banane ka matlab hai aisa content design aur tayyar karna jo har koi istemal kar sake, un logon samait jinhein disability (maazoori), jaise nazar ya sunne ki kamzori, ho. Agle do hisse batate hain: accessibility ke liye design, aur user feedback.

blocks.prompt: Digital content accessible kyun hona chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Ta ke nazar, sunne ya kisi aur maazoori wale log bhi maloomat aur services se faida utha sakein aur bahar na reh jayein.

items: Accessible content: aisa content jo har koi, disabled (maazoor) logon samait, istemal kar sake.
